Grab your sunglasses. It's time for burgers, lawn games and long evenings.

::: {.callout-bbq}
**When:** Saturday, July 17, 2027 · 4pm until the fireflies come out

**Where:** Rob's backyard, 123 Example Lane (see [Getting There](details.qmd))

**RSVP:** Contact Rob. Let him know how many are coming and any dietary needs.

## What to expect

- Burgers, veggie skewers and corn on the cob off the grill
- Cornhole and a croquet tournament (bragging rights only)
- A firepit and s'mores after sunset

Hungry already? See the [menu](menu.qmd).
